tools.name: abaninja_get_profile
tools.description: Return the AbaNinja profile of the user who owns the API token (name, email, role). Requires the profile scope. AbaNinja API: GET /users/v2/me.

tools.name: abaninja_list_accounts
tools.description: List the AbaNinja accounts this API token can access, with their uuid, name and role. Use it to find the account uuid. Requires the profile scope. AbaNinja API: GET /users/v2/me/accounts.

tools.name: abaninja_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices of the account (number, customer, dates, amounts, status), newest first. Set updated_since to get only recent changes. Results are under data.documents. Requires the customers scope. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/documents/v2/invoices.

tools.name: abaninja_get_invoice
tools.description: Return one invoice with its line items, customer, amounts and status. Requires the customers scope. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/documents/v2/invoices/{invoiceUuid}.

tools.name: abaninja_get_document_statistics
tools.description: Return counts of saved documents for the account and where they are stored. Useful as a quick summary of the account's document volume. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/documents/v2/statistics.

tools.name: abaninja_list_companies
tools.description: List company customers (name, customer number, VAT number, currency, contacts, addresses, payment terms). The API reference lists no extra scope for it. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/addresses/v2/companies.

tools.name: abaninja_get_company
tools.description: Return one company customer by uuid, with contacts, addresses, tags and payment terms. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/addresses/v2/companies/{companyUuid}.

tools.name: abaninja_list_persons
tools.description: List person customers (first and last name, customer number, contacts, addresses, payment terms). AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/addresses/v2/persons.

tools.name: abaninja_list_products
tools.description: List products and services (product key, name, price, tax rate, unit, archived status). Filter by product_key or set is_archived. Requires the products scope. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/products/v2/products.

tools.name: abaninja_get_product
tools.description: Return one product by uuid, with its price, tax rate, unit, group and translations. Requires the products scope. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/products/v2/products/{productUuid}.

tools.name: abaninja_list_employees
tools.description: List time-tracking employees of the account (name, job title, employee group, active status). Set only_inactive to list former employees. Requires the time-tracking scope. AbaNinja API: GET /accounts/{accountUuid}/time/v2/employees.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: abaninja_get_profile · Private data: abaninja_get_profile, abaninja_list_accounts, abaninja_list_invoices, abaninja_get_invoice, abaninja_get_document_statistics, abaninja_list_companies, abaninja_get_company, abaninja_list_persons · Public sink: abaninja_get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: abaninja_get_profile · Private data: abaninja_get_profile, abaninja_list_accounts, abaninja_list_invoices, abaninja_get_invoice, abaninja_get_document_statistics, abaninja_list_companies, abaninja_get_company, abaninja_list_persons · Public sink: abaninja_get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
